name: The live page says whether the two AIS feeds agree (signed in)
description: Validates the feed check on /live: each region both feeds cover gets one line whose verdict text matches its data-state, with the measured shares and their 90% and 95% targets.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /live and wait up to 60 seconds for the card "This moment" (data-testid live-moment) to show at least one feed check line (data-testid live-feed-check)
Assert each feed check line has data-state "agree" or "disagree", and reads "Feeds agree in the" when it is agree and "Feeds disagree in the" when it is disagree
Assert each line says what share "of aisstream's moving class A ships are also in Digitraffic (target 90%)" and what share of the shared positions "lie within 250 m (target 95%)"
Assert one of the lines names the Gulf of Finland
